SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-SQ-02: SQL-on-FHIR Analytics Layer — Runner materialization, Parameter binding, DuckDB execution semantics. Test these items: Each relatedArtifact materializes as CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "<label>" AS <generated SQL>; label quoted via viewdef.utils.quote_identifier, ViewDefinition dependencies generate SQL via viewdef.SQLGenerator(source_table=...) and become DuckDB views, SQLView dependencies recurse: materialize their own relatedArtifact first, then CREATE VIEW from their content.data SQL body, Dependency cycle detection (set of canonicals currently being resolved) raises SQLQueryCycleError before DuckDB execution, Content selection prefers 'application/sql;dialect=duckdb', falls back to 'application/sql', rejects other dialects with UnsupportedDialectError, Parameter binding via DuckDB prepared statements — no string interpolation of caller-supplied values anywhere on the parameter path, FHIR-type to DuckDB-type coercion via dict-driven registry in viewdef.types._FHIR_TYPE_TO_DUCKDB (string→VARCHAR, integer→INTEGER, decimal→DOUBLE, boolean→BOOLEAN, date→DATE, dateTime→TIMESTAMP, time→TIME, etc.), Missing required parameter raises SQLQueryTypeError with parameter name context, Wrong-type parameter (e.g., string for declared boolean/integer/decimal) raises SQLQueryTypeError with declared vs. got detail, Unsupported FHIR type (e.g., CodeableConcept, Quantity, Period — complex types not in the MVP registry) raises SQLQueryTypeError, Idempotent re-execution: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW does not error on existing view; callers may DROP VIEW to release names. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.summary: runner._coerce now casts temporal param strings through DuckDB prepared CAST to the registry type; failures raise SQLQueryTypeError with declared-vs-got detail; non-string temporals rejected in Python. Verified: 'not-a-date' now typed error; date comparison against DATE column correct.
explicit bool guard before int isinstance checks in _coerce (bool is an int subclass).
_INTEGER_RANGES enforces signed 32/64-bit widths for INTEGER/BIGINT with out-of-range SQLQueryTypeError; integer64 beyond int32 still accepted.
decimal.Decimal accepted for DOUBLE params, converted to float.
_expand_partial_temporal normalizes FHIR year/year-month precision (and date-only dateTime) to earliest instant via strict regex before the DuckDB cast.
